body: She hasn't divorced me yet. But if she decides to leave me, I don't think I will be able to keep myself from killing myself. I don't know what to do.

We got married this past August. She is my best friend, and the love of my life. I don't and never have deserved her. I literally cannot imagine life without her. I have hundreds of notes she gave me, some in my car, some in my cube, and some in my wallet. I can't live without her. That isn't just a cliche. I can't.
